propositions: warn_if_cache_ineffective emits false-positive warnings when input_tokens is below CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS (4096), causing alarm fatigue by firing ~20 times per run on small sub-floor calls where caching cannot work

the warning's predicate checks only input_tokens > 0 but lacks the upper-closed lower bound at CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS, creating indistinguishability between unreachable-floor prompts and genuinely broken caching
CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS constant is duplicated (defined in pass1.py, must also gate the warning in structured_run.py) creating a hand-sync risk similar to DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID
warnings should be gated on input_tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS to preserve the genuine opus-4-5 defect detection while eliminating sub-floor false positives
when caching does work (evidenced by positive aggregate cache_write_tokens), the warning should emit zero times for calls that fail to cache due to being below the floor
